location.title: Discover Paraty
location.description: We are in the historic center of Paraty, declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk through the charming cobblestone streets with the best restaurants, craft shops and historic landmarks: Santa Rita Church, Matriz Square, Nossa Senhora do Rosário and São Benedito Church and Nossa Senhora das Dores Church.
location.address: Rua Comendador José Luiz, 231 — House 07, Historic Center, Paraty/RJ
location.card_desc: A short walk from Matriz Church, Bandeira Square, art studios and the best restaurants.

poi.port: 10 min walk — Port and boat tours
